newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU 1997/98 farm price proposals due on Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: EU 1997/98 farm price proposals due on Feb 26.

text.p: European Union 1997/98 (July/June) farm price proposals are now due to be presented by the European Commission on February 26, Commission officials said on Wednesday.
The proposals had originally been envisaged for February 12 so that they could be presented to EU farm ministers the following week.
"The figures need to be recalculated in view of 1998 budget guidelines set by the Commission last week," said an official.
Spending plans will have to be cut by up to 2.5 billion Ecus in order to meet budget constraints arising mainly from the need to prepare for a single EU currency.
Commission sources said on Tuesday that a fresh attempt would be made to cut cereals compensatory payments in order to meet the budget target.
Last autumn a proposed seven percent cut, which would have saved around 1.3 billion Ecus, was rejected by farm ministers.

The payments, agreed in 1992 to offset cuts in intervention prices, have become increasingly difficult to justify after cereal market prices soared above official support levels and with most of the aid going to the largest farmers.
